name: The Collector's Journey
description: The structured path a new Collector follows from arrival at the Convergence Hub through the liberation of all Legendary Nikes and the revelation of the 5,555 Prophecy.

overview.premise: A new Dimensional Walker falls through a convergence point and arrives at the Convergence Hub. Hub Charles recognizes them as a potential Collector—someone capable of bonding with Nikes and protecting them from Nolem's corruption. Charles AI provides dimensional transit and tactical support. The Walker must travel across eight dimensions, freeing corrupted Legendary Nikes and building the bonds that will one day complete Nike Prime.
overview.distinction: Dimensional Walkers can survive dimensional transit. Collectors are Walkers who can BOND with Nikes. Not all Walkers become Collectors—the bond requires mutual trust, not capture.

events: Walker falls through an unstable dimensional tear, arriving at the Hub
Hub Charles and Piglet Nike find the Walker and provide orientation
Retnuhxed track the dimensional tear and breach the Hub perimeter
Walker chooses a starter Nike (Piglet Nike, Emo Nike, or Chef Nike) and fights
Hub Charles explains the Collector's purpose: bonding protects Nikes from corruption
Charles AI is introduced as the separate dimensional transit and communication system
Hub Charles shares his vigil—a memorial of every Walker he couldn't save
Hub Charles explains Nolem, the First Bond, and the stakes
Distress signal from a collapsing dimension reaches Charles AI
Walker enters the dying world to find Elena, a veteran Collector
Together they rescue 17 dormant Nikes from the collapsing reality
Elena becomes a mentor figure, demonstrating advanced Collector techniques
The Blackout Beast—first major combat challenge
Elena's rescue establishes the stakes: dimensions are actively dying

triforceSystem.description: A fellow Collector named Alice introduces the Triforce system—the three mechanisms that justify and explain PvP between Collectors.

mechanisms.name: Corruption Discharge
mechanisms.explanation: When two Collectors battle, the friction of clashing bonds burns off residual corruption from their Nikes. PvP is literally therapeutic.

mechanisms.name: Genetic Memory Exchange
mechanisms.explanation: Nikes that battle each other share trace genetic memories. Both grow stronger from the exchange. Competition strengthens the whole.

mechanisms.name: Convergence Web
mechanisms.explanation: Every battle between Collectors strengthens the web of bonds across the multiverse. The more connections, the harder it is for Nolem to isolate and corrupt individual Nikes.

triforceSystem.lorePurpose: The Triforce system ensures that Collector-vs-Collector battles are not contradictions to the mission—they actively advance it.

harbingerBriefing.description: Hub Charles briefs the Walker on the six Harbingers—corrupted Collectors (the player-kind) who serve as Nolem's regional lieutenants, each blocking the path to a Legendary Nike. Each fell for deeply personal, tragic reasons.

dimensionProgression.description: The Walker travels to each dimension in a gated progression based on level and bonds formed.

act1Structure.pattern: Each dimension follows the same narrative arc in Act 1
steps: Arrive in the dimension, meet the local Charles Variant
Explore the region, learn its history and how corruption changed it
Encounter and defeat the regional Harbinger
Face the corrupted Legendary Nike (the region's boss)
Free the Legendary, beginning the dimension's healing

act2Structure.pattern: DEFEATING the Act 1 Legendary unlocks deeper content in each dimension (never gate on _freed — a KO-path player must reach it; both resolutions count). Opens IN-REGION and IMMEDIATELY — never 'return after the campaign'. Ruling 2026-07-27, unanimous: Deep tier is per-region, gated on <region>_anchor_defeated + the region's DEEP-TIER floor (NOT the band floor — free-order siblings are co-banded, so the band floor would open the Deep tier the instant the anchor fell), never campaign_complete
steps: Return to the dimension after Act 1 completion
Discover hidden Legendaries revealed by the healing process
Face 2-5 additional Legendary Nikes per region
Uncover deeper lore about the Prime Era and Nolem's methods

regions.name: Imperial Colosseum
regions.majorReveal: The Scholar Bunker — Nike Prime's growth chamber, the missing empathy core, the 5,555 prophecy first explained

regions.name: Neon City
regions.note: Act 2 Legendaries exist as corrupted programs in the Deep Network

regions.name: Void Terminus
regions.note: OG Nike serves as guide, not boss. Elbonzys is a gatekeeper test, not a corruption fight.

regions.name: Nolem's Maw
regions.majorReveal: The 5,555 Prophecy — Scholar recording confirms Nike Prime's incomplete state and the path to victory
regions.note: Melon Nike is unique: willingly chose Nolem, completely uncorrupted. The Betrayer.

endgame.description: After clearing Nolem's Maw, the Collector understands the true mission: gathering 5,555 bonds to complete Nike Prime's missing empathy core. The war continues.
endgame.truthRevealed: Nike Prime's whereabouts have been unknown since the Prime Era. Without the empathy core, he cannot bond the trap shut. The trap is slowly weakening.
endgame.truthRevealedNote: CORRECTED 2026-07-29. Formerly asserted he 'is still inside the trap with Nolem, fighting endlessly for three thousand years' — contradicted by the Tier-1 source (Nolem went alone; Prime and Shiro detached and landed alive, comic-books/book-01/script.md:1033) AND foreclosed by the owner's ruling that the Long Silence is open expansion space. OPEN CONSEQUENCE: the weakening trap now needs a cause that does not depend on Nike Prime being inside it, since he demonstrably left. A later re-entry remains available as a future-comic option and would restore the original wording — but it is not canon until ruled.
endgame.prophecy: Nike Prime isn't one soul carrying 5,555. Nike Prime IS 5,555 souls carrying each other.
endgame.path_forward: Every Nike caught, every Legendary freed, every bond formed between Collectors—it all counts toward the 5,555 needed to complete Nike Prime and seal Nolem forever.
